# GradeSpot IT Solutions

> GradeSpot IT Solutions (GradeSpot IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.) is an IT training institute and IT services company in Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It offers professional training programs for corporates and students across computer hardware, networking, cybersecurity, cloud computing, digital marketing and data science, with online and offline classes, plus IT services, corporate trainings, internships and certificate verification.

## Contact

- Address: 16-126, 2nd Floor, Near Sai Baba Temple, Road No.1, Sri Krishna Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana - 500060
- Phone: +91 91826 54056
- Email: info@gsitssolutions.com
- Office Hours: 8:00 AM - 9:00 PM
